metadata.title: Northline Bank credit decisioning system security plan
metadata.remarks: Fictional OSCAL SSP for a tier-1 bank. It follows the shape of the EU AI Act template SSP and asserts nothing about a real system.

system-characteristics.description: High-risk creditworthiness AI system and the delivery toolchain that builds it.

information-types.title: Credit application data
information-types.description: Application features, decision outcome, and model version used for a consumer credit decision.

authorization-boundary.description: The credit model service, its decision API, the CI/CD platform that releases it, and the secrets service that holds its keys.

authorized-privileges.title: Interrupt an automated credit outcome
functions-performed: stop or return the application for manual review

components.title: Credit decisioning model service
components.description: Online service that scores a credit application and records the model version.

components.title: Payments and model delivery pipeline
components.description: CI/CD platform that builds, signs, and promotes payment and model releases.

components.title: Secrets service
components.description: Approved store for application secrets and signing keys.

control-implementation.description: One implemented requirement for each control selected by the Northline tier-1 profile.

implemented-requirements.description: Credit decisioning is recorded as Annex III point 5(b). No Article 6(3) derogation is claimed.
Lifecycle risk management is documented in POL-AIR-007 and reviewed on model change.
Training and production credit data are catalogued, access-controlled, and checked for errors.
Each decision stores inputs, model version, and outcome under POL-LOG-005.
Credit decision reviewers can interrupt an automated outcome under POL-ACC-004.
Accuracy limits and endpoint protections are required before a model is promoted. Residual gap is tracked in the POA&M.
Model and service changes pass the quality system described in POL-SSD-001.
Serious incidents in the credit system follow the reporting deadlines in POL-INC-006.
Compliance records penalty exposure for missed AI obligations under POL-REG-008.
Production changes require peer review and a change record under POL-SSD-001.
The delivery pipeline signs release artifacts and rejects unsigned production deploys.
Secrets and signing keys are held in the secrets service under POL-SEC-002.
Dependencies are scanned every 7 days, the value set on ds-vm-1_prm_1.
Admin and release events are logged under POL-LOG-005.
Workforce and privileged access follow POL-ACC-004.
Security incidents have an owner and a severity under POL-INC-006.
Each production release stores an SBOM and build provenance.
